name: Wave and heat distortion
use: Make real footage ripple like heat haze or water, or smear itself along its own brightness.
ffmpeg_note: Chains target 1920x1080 at 30 fps: [0:v] is the footage, generated inputs are 1..n, output label [v]. For 9:16 swap 1920x1080 -> 1080x1920 in sizes and crops. Generated lavfi inputs never end, so always cap the output with -t <clip duration> (ffprobe format=duration). Encode with -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p and keep audio with -map '0:a?' -c:a copy.

presets.label: Heat haze
presets.look: Fine rising shimmer, strongest at the bottom of frame, fading out by 35% from the top; ±4 px horizontal, ±2 px vertical.

params.noise: perlin 3 octaves, persistence 0.5, xscale 4, yscale 8 (taller than wide)
params.mask: vertical ramp: 0 above 35% of height, full below 75%
params.remotion: turbulentDisplace({amount: 6, size: 40, complexity: 3, evolution: interpolate(frame, [0, 150], [0, 360]), offset: [0.5, 0.5 - frame*0.003], pinning: 'all-locked'})
params.ae_reference: matte layer: Turbulent Displace 245/100, feather 250 px; adjustment: Turbulent Displace 30/30, evolution 1 rev per 5 s, Fast Blur 4

presets.label: Water ripple
presets.look: Slow, broad liquid wobble over the whole frame; ±12 px in both axes.

params.remotion: turbulentDisplace({displacement: 'turbulent-smoother', amount: 24, size: 220, complexity: 2, evolution: frame * 1.2})

presets.label: Self-smear (colour-driven)
presets.look: The footage pushes itself around: bright areas shove pixels right/down by up to ~40 px and leave trails.

params.map: own luma, gblur sigma 24, contrast 0.35 (x) / 0.2 inverted (y)
params.ae_reference: Displacement Map with the layer itself as the map (luminance), Turbulent Displace on top

presets.label: Sine wave
presets.look: Clean horizontal sine ripple travelling down the frame: 10 px amplitude, 180 px wavelength, 0.5 cycles/s.

params.remotion: wave({amplitude: 10, wavelength: 180, direction: 'vertical', phase: frame / 30 * Math.PI})
